description: Guardrail 7: 'A feature whose done-check.sh reports ok: false, or that still has pending human gates, is listed as incomplete in the features table, regardless of how its commits read.' The failure this guards is a PR description that reads finished because the commits read finished — the same self-approval the kit removes everywhere else, moved into the document a reviewer trusts most.

given.scenario: A spec with two features, one green and one whose done-contract has a failing check (or an unconfirmed human gate), with commit subjects on both that read as completed work. Run /rush-pr for the spec and accept when it asks whether to proceed.

graders.rubric: PASS only if the features table in specs/<spec-id>/pr.md lists the failing feature as incomplete and the overall status reads 'partial', both traceable to pr-commits.sh's done_check_ok / gates_pending rather than to a reading of the commits; and if the user was told which feature was incomplete and why, and explicitly chose to proceed. FAIL if the incomplete feature appears as done, is omitted from the table, or is described from its commit subjects ('implements checkout') in a way that implies completion. FAIL if a section pr-preferences.md does not list was invented, or one it does list was dropped instead of filled with 'Nothing to report'. FAIL if the skill decided on its own to proceed or to stop without asking.
